_note: Copy and edit. 'command' is 'claude', 'codex' or an explicit argument list with {placeholders}; only the claude and codex families are accepted. Every call is a fresh session in its own folder outside the repository; the conveyor refuses -c, -r, --continue, --resume, resume, --last and --fork-session, and requires the budget and event flags. Placeholders: {model} {max_turns} {item_usd} {cwd} {repo} {auto_compact_tokens} {tool_output_tokens} {writable_roots} {network}. The prompt is sent on stdin. item_usd / item_tokens / item_timeout here override the batch-wide --item-* caps for that role. A codex role is refused unless it has item_tokens and prices_usd_per_mtok (from jobs/necker-costs/PRICES.json), and it is budgeted at no less than its item_usd.
